title: Multicolor Ramsey and list Ramsey numbers for star-like trees
summary: For a graph \(H\), the \(k\)-color Ramsey number \(r(H;k)\) is the least integer \(N\) such that every \(k\)-edge-coloring of \(K_N\) contains a monochromatic copy of \(H\). A \(k\)-list assignment has \(|L(e)|=k\) for every edge. The list Ramsey number \(r_\ell(H;k)\) is the least integer \(N\) for which there exists a \(k\)-list assignment on \(E(K_N)\) such that every coloring from the lists contains a monochromatic copy of \(H\).
